prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE new high-quality production full-body RPG combat sprite on real transparent RGBA, square canvas about 1536x1536.
Image 1: APPROVED JOKRO source artwork, sole identity/costume/color reference. It is immutable; make a separate derivative. Image 2: grip mechanics reference ONLY. Do not copy image 2's character, low crouch, outfit, yellow/blue lightning or style.

BATTLE ADAPTATION: ONE single katana in one matching black scabbard. NO mouth sword, no second sword, no third sword. Calm closed mouth. UPRIGHT standing iaido ready posture; no deep waist bend or low crouch. Full adult body, natural small head, long legs, all boots and scabbard visible. Three-quarter view facing SCREEN RIGHT. Level camera, no exaggerated foreshortening. Natural weight on two grounded feet, modest knee flexion, torso almost vertical and shoulders relaxed.
The sword sits at the character's left hip. The sheath's tip trails BEHIND toward SCREEN LEFT. The handle extends FORWARD toward SCREEN RIGHT. The RIGHT hand firmly closes around the handle just in front of the guard; the LEFT hand holds the sheath mouth just behind the guard, thumb at the guard to unlock. This is a coherent sword inside a sheath, grip centerline continuing through guard into scabbard. Only a tiny 2cm blade gleam may be exposed, no full drawn blade. User grip reference shows hand mechanics; mirror its screen direction as needed to face right. Hands must convincingly grip rather than hover. Five fingers and believable thumbs, clear wrist contact. No kink, crooked joint, disconnected metal or duplicated hilt.

Match image 1 EXACT character: handsome adult male face and intense emerald eyes, softly flowing dark forest-green hair matching the approved painting, NO wet greasy clumps, no segmented plastic hair plates; black contemporary long special-forces coat, silver buttons and fine silver piping, fitted black shirt and trousers, black belt, flat black combat boots, deep emerald dragon-embroidered coat lining visible in two restrained trailing tails. Keep the crowned feline/C9 intertwined sleeve crest seen in the approved artwork; NO extra standalone C9 lettering, no chest logo. Coat must look modern, not Chinese historical robes. Face, hands, hair and costume all in the same polished 2D anime/painterly style as approved art. No chibi, no inflated head, no redesign.
Preserve natural katana proportions: blade would be about 65–70cm on a 180cm adult, handle about24cm, understated gold fittings with smooth gentle curve. Sword/sheath must not be stretched to fit the pose.

ASSET: one isolated opaque physical character, restrained emerald rim reflected ON surfaces only. No dragon, aura, green clouds, particles, background, ground, shadow, checkerboard, frame, labels or watermark. All surrounding pixels transparent. At least 12% clear padding around hair, coat tails, both boots and sword/sheath tip. The entire coherent silhouette fits comfortably. Strong premium material and face detail suitable for SSS LIMITED battle quality.
